text: Implemented explicit decode/reconstruction semantics: LatentMaterializationTerm and LatentDecodeSemantics now distinguish linear coefficient decode from offsets and residual events; Explicit, Transport, and BOLDZip responses expose semantics from instance state; tests cover DCT, Haar, shared-basis materialized responses, transport, and BOLDZip.
